task.title: Live workout audit — HealthKit workout recording + Phone/Watch latency

result.summary: Build 85 starts a Watch HKWorkoutSession only via iPhone Ready for Watch then Watch Start Workout; phone-started live sessions never record HealthKit, so Watch Active/Total Calories and Heart Rate stay blank while TIME (phone anchors) advances. Every Watch activation refresh occupies the single-flight command gate and disables Complete Set until the phone replies.
result.blank_metrics_likely_cause: no_hkworkoutsession_phone_started (high confidence; alternative: Watch Health read permission denied)

recommended_next_step: Founder/ChatGPT decide: patch during or after the workout; F1 auto vs explicit Watch Health start for phone-started sessions; late-start trusted-correlation policy; then authorize F1-F3 implementation with the listed deterministic tests.
stop_reason: Audit and fix recommendation complete per governing prompt; implementation not authorized.
